industry.drivers: GST 2.0 rate cuts (Sep-2025) lifted volumes from H2FY26; electrification (e-2W >10% of registrations in Q1FY27); premiumisation (TFT clusters, smart access, HV harnesses); CAFE norms from Apr-2027; export opportunity (India auto-component exports $23 bn in FY25 to $70-100 bn by FY30 per ACMA/McKinsey, quoted in the Vision 2030 deck).
industry.headwinds: Copper, zinc and aluminium up 30-40% during FY26 (pass-through without margin); labour codes and minimum-wage increases; freight; West Asia conflict; the GST-boosted base from Q3FY27.

excluded.BHARATFORG: Earnings distorted: a Rs358 cr exceptional charge turned the Jun-2026 quarter into a loss, so its ~93x trailing P/E on 30-Sep-2026 sits on depressed TTM EPS (as in the Uno Minda, Motherson, Bosch and Endurance initiations).
excluded.GABRIEL: No five-year history: Screener's P/E series starts in May-2024 (after Gabriel's restructuring).

peers.notes: The auto-component peer set used in the Bosch, Motherson, Uno Minda and Endurance initiations (same as-of date), with Minda Corporation itself left out. Tyre and battery makers are excluded (different raw-material cycles). SCHAEFFLER (December year-end) has P/E history only from Feb-2023, MSUMI from Apr-2022 and ZFCVINDIA from May-2022: their medians cover the history available. Direct business peers (Motherson Sumi Wiring in harnesses, Uno Minda in switches/lighting, Pricol in clusters, Sandhar in locks) are shown in the peer table.

brokers.thesis: Robust Q1 (revenue 6-7% above estimates); momentum in harness, clusters, vehicle access and die casting; Flash share Rs80/101/122 cr; ~18/19/25% revenue/EBITDA/EPS CAGR FY26-29E. TP raised from Rs775.
Solid execution; premiumisation and new contracts in clusters and harness, die-casting exports, Vast smart locks; estimates unchanged, TP rolled forward from Rs825.
Beat on revenue, EBITDA and PAT; premiumisation, content per vehicle, Vast consolidation; Rs2,500 cr of new orders; Flash EV +90%.
Post-Q4FY26 note (method not disclosed in our source).
Electronics, EVs and system-level wins accelerating compounding (post-Q4FY26).
Premium electronics, EV electronics and content-per-vehicle gains; order book >Rs10,000 cr; EPS raised ~10%.

street.consensusNote: Every broker we found standing on 30-Sep-2026 rates the stock Buy. Post-Q1 targets Rs815-867 on 32-34x FY28E/Jun-28E EPS. Brokers do not dilute EPS for the 76.5 lakh promoter warrants (Emkay and MNCL use 239.1 mn shares).
street.excludedNotes: FundsIndia (BUY Rs766, 39x FY28E) is dated 19-Oct-2026 and Emkay's and Axis's Nov-2026 notes follow Q2FY27: all after the as-of date, excluded. Nuvama (Rs620, 32x Sep-27E, Sep-2025) is stale.

stockEvents: Warrants to promoter at Rs550 approved
moat: Supplies most Indian 2W and CV makers; kit value rises with TFT clusters, HV harnesses, smart access
Growth above industry (FY26 +22% vs production +12%) but no evidence of pricing power
Flash (EV power electronics), Toyodenso, HCMF, Turntide, VAST, Furukawa, SANCO
Access to technology, but partners own 40-51% of several ventures and the JVs are still start-ups
Rs6,185 cr revenue vs Motherson Sumi Wiring (~Rs10,000 cr) in harness, Uno Minda Rs19,658 cr
Mid-sized in every category it plays in
Commodity pass-through with a 1-2 quarter lag and no margin on the pass-through
Flash goodwill (~Rs1,200 cr above book) dilutes group returns
critiques: Growth is broad: harness and clusters +30-35% in Q1; Vision 2030 Rs17,500 cr revenue; 33x Jun-28E.
Attractive valuations; Vast to grow fast with smart locks.
Interest and depreciation costs are monitorables; margins under input-cost pressure.
Flash and the new JVs are minority stakes: their EV growth reaches Minda only as share of profit, and two-wheeler EV makers could bring motors and controllers in-house.
GAM Research (Q1FY27 call: Flash EV revenue ~30% of its total)
Q1FY27's 33% growth includes ~Rs125 cr from consolidating Vast: organic growth was ~24%.

gaps: No vertical profitability is disclosed (single Ind AS 108 segment); vertical revenue only from presentations; Q2FY25 and Q2FY26 derived.

Minda Vast's Mar-2026 balance sheet (total assets Rs269 cr, liabilities Rs156 cr) is not split into debt, fixed assets and working capital; the model does not add it to the FY26 balance sheet (see text).
Named mutual-fund schemes above 1% (Jun-2026) not available from our sources; category totals used.
Geojit's and DR Choksey's valuation methods not disclosed in our sources; a Haitong initiation (Jun-2026) is mentioned in aggregators but could not be verified from a dated source.
Flash's PPA amortisation inside the share of profit is not disclosed separately (CFO cites 'excess depreciation').
FY20 and FY21 exceptional items (Rs196 cr and Rs41 cr after tax, Screener) are before our valuation window; their composition is not analysed.
conflicts: Q1FY27 exceptional gain: Rs124 cr pre-tax / Rs106 cr after tax (company) vs Rs99 cr after tax (Screener schedule). We use the company's figures.
Q1FY27 adjusted PAT: ~Rs100 cr (reported Rs206 cr less Rs106 cr) vs Rs82 cr in Emkay and MNCL (they deduct the pre-tax gain). We use ~Rs100 cr.
Q1FY27 organic growth: ~24% (company: Vast added ~Rs125 cr) vs 26% (MNCL). We use 24%.

Vision 2030 Rs17,500 cr: the Vision deck shows it as 3.5x FY25 consolidated revenue; on the Q4FY26 call management said it is a group figure including Flash and inorganic moves. We treat it as a group figure.
